function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd libpcap
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
make
for target in pcap filter both
do
    $CC $CFLAGS -I.. -c ../testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_$target.c -o fuzz_$target.o
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS fuzz_$target.o -o $OUT/fuzz_$target libpcap.a -lFuzzingEngine
done
cd ..
cp testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_*.options $OUT/
cd $SRC/tcpdump/
zip -r fuzz_pcap_seed_corpus.zip tests/
cp fuzz_pcap_seed_corpus.zip $OUT/
cd $SRC/libpcap/testprogs/BPF
mkdir corpus
ls *.txt | while read i; do tail -1 $i > corpus/$i; done
zip -r fuzz_filter_seed_corpus.zip corpus/
cp fuzz_filter_seed_corpus.zip $OUT/
938817d6 Handle *all* protocol qualifiers in gen_host() - even link/tr/etc.
93ef2c8a Add checks for invalid "direction" qualifiers for "decnet".
0d71eade Catch shifts > 31 bits generated by the optimizer.
546a14a9 Report an error for MPLS labels that don't fit in 20 bits.
9b3d3876 Report an error for too-large VLAN tags, PPPoE session numbers, and Geneve VNIs.
1c26c7de Don't longjmp out of the generated parser.
9e644b5b Handle all protocol qualifiers in gen_proto().
cd512217 Make qerr const.
52a246fb Handle negation in a way that doesn't upset compilers or UBSan.
849ca429 Fix compiling with optimizer debugging enabled.
e8767c3b Don't call setjmp in code we didn't write.
28c9b1a7 Attempt to squelch a "clobbered by longjmp" warning.
12f7e1fb Another attempt to fix a "clobbered by longjmp" warning.
dfafa1f9 We can't longjmp out of sdup(), as it's called in the lexical analyzer.
fec78545 Fix another place where longjmp() was called without a setjmp().
68e9a06e Catch errors reported by gen_retblk().
d9500279 finish_parse() has to catch bpf_error() exceptions, too.
